authorization: Local comparison online/full replay/cautious hybrid; Open15 maximum released as hard constraint; prepare final candidate, no platform actions.
hybrid_rule: Replay only if physical newT <= same online shadow T and placement touches a free-gap boundary after required extension. Otherwise permanent handoff to same core from actual geometry. No guarantee after handoff.
budget: Exactly three strategy candidates, calibration64, final128, Open15, three new 200000-command resource stress streams. Implementation correctness fixes allowed before final freeze; no policy tuning on final results.

selection.validation: All trajectories legal, official interactive confirmation, CPU<5s and RSS<256MiB on local host. Native Windows/G5420 remains separate.
selection.metrics: Family-macro absolute KPI in ordinary and public-prefix strata; paired relative retention, worst losses, and Open15 weighted score.
selection.selection_rule: Among correct candidates with ordinary and prefix family-macro KPI each >= online - 0.002 and no ordinary case KPI < 0.80*online, choose smallest maximum regret across scenario mixtures p=0 and p=1, score=Open15+84*((1-p)*ordinary_macro+p*prefix_macro). Scenario distribution is illustrative, not estimated hidden distribution. Ties within 0.01 score choose simpler online, then hybrid, then full.
selection.confirmation_rule: Freeze selected candidate and all binaries before opening final results. Recheck same two macro floors and ordinary per-case retention on independent final128. Failure returns recommendation to online without retuning. Report all three results, including losses.
selection.statistical_scope: Synthetic mechanisms, not a sample of official hidden distribution. Bootstrap family blocks, descriptive intervals only.

host: macOS arm64; one solver process at a time for official resource measurements
